featured_reviews.review_text:
A good next door convenience store
Liberty supermarket is prominently located on the Kohinoor Hospital-Holy Cross Road.A shop a part of the commercial complex of Phase 3 Kohinoor city. A well stocked convenience store one can find quality goods-groceries chocolates snacks - Indian and imported.The shop has also recently tied up with A P Mani groceries- a reputed brand in fresh vegetables retail supply.Under the arrangement it now houses limited varieties of fresh vegetables produce marketed by A  P Mani.
Arranged in a modern cash and carry- Supermarket format the goods are quiet conveniently placed.It also houses good collection of dry fruits dates and exotic chocolates. A pleasant fulky air conditioned environmental the place is never over crowded.It accepts both cash as well as card and digital payment modules.

featured_reviews.name: Akhilesh Prajapati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its located in a very convenient and accessible area, which is one of its biggest advantages. The location is really good, making it easy for people from nearby areas to visit without much difficulty.

The store usually has a good crowd, but everything is well-organized. You can find a wide variety of products—from groceries and household items to daily essentials—all under one roof. One of the best things about this DMart is that the prices are generally cheaper, which makes it a great option for regular shopping.

The staff are polite and helpful, and the overall shopping experience feels smooth. Everything is arranged properly, and the store feels normal and comfortable to shop in.

featured_reviews.name: Digital Omkar karjekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A pleasant shopping experience is something I always look forward to, and that’s exactly what I get at DMart. I regularly purchase my household essentials from this store, and every visit has been smooth and convenient.
The staff members are friendly, approachable, and always ready to help if I’m unable to find a product. Billing is usually fast, even during busy hours, and the store is well-organized, which makes shopping easy and comfortable.
I also appreciate the cleanliness and proper arrangement of items on shelves. Overall, the service quality and positive attitude of the team make me prefer DMart Vidyavihar for my regular shopping.

Overall a good place to find every house hold item under one roof.

featured_reviews.review_text:
​I am writing to express my strong dissatisfaction regarding the delivery of my recent order, which was originally scheduled for yesterday.
​Despite my expectations, the package was not delivered yesterday as promised. I was informed it would arrive today instead; however, I am still waiting. I have specifically set aside significant time on both days to ensure someone was available to receive this order, resulting in a great deal of personal inconvenience.
​Furthermore, I have already paid the required delivery charges for a service that has not been fulfilled according to the agreed timeline. My time is valuable, and the lack of communication and repeated delays are unacceptable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Reliance SMART: A Smart Choice for Family Shopping
Located at the Ground Floor of Market City Mall in Phoenix Market City, Reliance SMART is a truly comprehensive shopping destination. It offers a wide variety of products, making it a convenient one-stop-shop for many households.
This store is a great window for shopping, providing everything from groceries, snacks, and toiletries to utensils and even clothes. As the saying goes, "you name it, you'll find it there" (except for electronics). This vast selection, combined with its affordability, makes it highly recommended for any middle-class family.
While the store is a great choice for variety, the service needs to be upgraded for efficiency and productivity. Improving this aspect would make an already great shopping experience even better.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Why is this store an absolute mess? Inventory tossed all over the aisles during a busy afternoon. Customers having to step over boxes tossed carelessly around the store.

Why does Reliance take no pride in keeping their stores organized, clean and efficient? Many of their stores are disorganised and full of too many staff who just stand around chatting with each other and watching their phones?

Why are store inventory changes not made after hours instead of during busy afternoon periods?

It seems that Reliance Fresh enjoys a monopoly in many parts of India and has no interest in improving their services and customer experience. They will eventually be out competed by better stores that take pride in their stores and making customers happy.

I had a disappointing experience at Smart Bazaar. The staff was not helpful when I was trying to find a product, and I didn’t receive any proper assistance.

featured_reviews.review_text: The service is super slow. Today, one of their cashiers (I won't tell the name) at R city just refused to give 18 Rs change for a 52 Rs Bill (cash given by client 70 Rs). Her cash drawer was bursting with change (strange). But she said no change. She issued the bill and the customer had to pay at the counter opposite it (customer service as the Store Managers are never there). featured_reviews.name: komal jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last week I bought black raisins, ate them for three days, and on the fourth day I found out they were FULL of worms. When I emptied the packet onto a plate, it was disgusting — literally filled with worms. Imagine eating that without knowing.
And the worst part? When I went to the shop, the young owner didn’t even have the basic decency to talk to me. He behaved like I was disturbing him and acted as if selling spoiled, worm-infested food was normal. He pushed me off to his staff and refused to take any responsibility. Instead of apologising or fixing the issue, they insulted me by weighing the leftover raisins and offering a tiny refund — like they were doing me a favour. Pathetic.
No sorry, no concern, no accountability. I threw the bill there and told them to keep the money. A store that sells rotten products AND treats customers like they’re asking for charity has no shame. They only care about profit, not about the people who trust them.
Because I was a regular customer, I avoided creating a scene in the crowd and went at closing time thinking about their shop. That was my biggest mistake — I should have exposed them right there in front of all the customers.
